briefing: This is {PATRON}, and this conversation never happened.
Three tonnes of narcotics need to move from {HERE} to a neighbour world, past every patrol on the way.
Land it unscanned and you are paid at the far end. Get scanned, and you were never here.
dossier.lead: Word reaches the commander that {PATRON} wants a quiet talk at {WORLD}.

run.arrive: Land the narcotics at {TARGET} unscanned for {PAY}
run.success: The narcotics reached {TARGET} unscanned, and {PAY} is yours
run.fail: The narcotics never reached {TARGET}, and {PAY} stays unpaid

dossier.news: Locals say {PATRON} at {WORLD} is looking for a pilot willing to keep quiet.

rumour.far: Rumour on the board says {PATRON} at {WORLD} pays well for quiet cargo runs.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}: the quiet job still needs a pilot.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander took a quiet cargo job tied to {WORLD}.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the narcotics run was done, and the commander's ties to {WORLD} stayed hidden.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the deal collapsed, and the commander's name was linked to {WORLD}.

run.success: By day {DAY}, the commander landed the narcotics at {WORLD} without a scan.
run.failed: By day {DAY}, the commander failed to land the narcotics at {WORLD} before the deadline.

dossier.title: Past the Patrols
